# hyper.lime

> Open-source React UI component library for AI-generated ("vibe-coded") apps. Zero runtime dependencies beyond React. All styling is plain CSS with CSS variables. Class names are stable and prefixed with `vb-`.

Install: `npm i hyperlime` (peer dependency: react >= 18)

## Conventions (follow these exactly)

- Every component accepts standard HTML/React props via spread (`onClick`, `style`, `aria-*`, `data-*`).
- Variants always use the `variant` prop. Sizes always use the `size` prop with values `"sm" | "md" | "lg"`.
- Selection inputs (`Checkbox`, `Switch`, `RadioGroup`, `Slider`, `Rating`, `ToggleButtonGroup`, `NumberField`, `Pagination`, `BottomNavigation`, `Tabs`, `ToggleButtonGroup`) are controlled: pass `value`/`checked` + `onChange`.
- Form fields (`Input`, `Textarea`, `Select`, `Autocomplete`, `NumberField`) share: `label?: string`, `hint?: string`, `error?: string` (error overrides hint and turns red), `id?: string` (links label to field).
- Status colors always use: `"success" | "warning" | "error" | "info"` (Badge/Chip/Toast also accept `"default"` and `"accent"`).
- Theming is CSS variables: `--accent`, `--bg`, `--bg-elevated`, `--bg-hover`, `--border`, `--border-strong`, `--text`, `--text-muted`, `--text-faint`, `--radius-sm|md|lg`, `--font-sans`, `--font-mono`. Dark mode is `[data-theme="light"]` on `<html>` (default is dark).
- Import anything from the package root: `import { Button, Card } from "hyperlime"`.

## Inputs

### Button
Pill-shaped action button.
Props: `variant: "primary" | "secondary" | "ghost" | "danger" = "primary"`, `size: "sm" | "md" | "lg" = "md"`, `disabled?: boolean`, `children: node`, `...button props`.
```jsx
<Button variant="secondary" size="lg">Cancel</Button>
<Button><Spinner /> Loading</Button>
```

### IconButton
Square icon-only button. Requires `label` (used as aria-label).
Props: `variant?: "default" | "accent" = "default"`, `size?: "sm" | "md" = "md"`, `label: string`, `children: node`.
```jsx
<IconButton label="Delete"><Icon name="trash" /></IconButton>
```

### ButtonGroup
Joins Buttons into one segmented control.
Props: `children: node` (two or more `<Button>`).
```jsx
<ButtonGroup><Button variant="secondary">Left</Button><Button variant="secondary">Right</Button></ButtonGroup>
```

### Fab (Floating Action Button)
56px circular accent button.
Props: `icon?: node = "+"`, `label: string`, `onClick?: fn`.
```jsx
<Fab icon="+" label="Create" onClick={create} />
```

### SpeedDial
Fab that expands into labeled mini actions.
Props: `actions: { label: string, icon: node, onSelect?: fn }[]`.
```jsx
<SpeedDial actions={[{ label: "Upload", icon: "↑", onSelect: upload }]} />
```

### Input (Text Field)
Labeled text input.
Props: `label?: string`, `hint?: string`, `error?: string`, `id?: string`, `...input props` (placeholder, value, onChange, type, defaultValue).
```jsx
<Input label="Email" placeholder="ada@lovelace.dev" hint="We never share your email." />
<Input label="API key" error="Invalid key format." />
```

### Textarea
Multi-line input. Props: same as Input. `rows?: number = 3`.
```jsx
<Textarea label="Prompt" placeholder="Describe what to build..." />
```

### TextareaAutosize
Auto-growing textarea. Props: `minRows?: number = 2`, `maxRows?: number = 10`, `...textarea props`.

### Select
Native styled dropdown.
Props: `options: string[] = []`, `label?: string`, `id?: string`, `...select props` (value, onChange).
```jsx
<Select label="Region" options={["eu-1", "us-1", "ap-1"]} />
```

### Autocomplete
Text input with a filtered suggestion panel.
Props: `options: string[] = []`, `label?: string`, `placeholder?: string`, `id?: string`.

### NumberField
Number input with +/- steppers.
Props: `label?: string`, `value: number`, `onChange: (n: number) => void`, `min?: number = 0`, `max?: number = 100`, `step?: number = 1`, `id?: string`.

### Checkbox
Props: `label?: string`, `checked: boolean`, `onChange: fn`, `id?: string`.
```jsx
<Checkbox id="nl" label="Subscribe" checked={on} onChange={() => setOn(!on)} />
```

### RadioGroup
Props: `name: string` (required), `options: string[]` (required), `value: string`, `onChange: (v: string) => void`.

### Switch
Toggle. Props: `checked: boolean`, `onChange: fn`, `label?: string`, `id?: string`.

### Slider
Props: `value: number = 0`, `onChange: (n: number) => void`, `min?: number = 0`, `max?: number = 100`, `label?: string` (shows live readout).

### Rating
Star rating. Props: `value: number = 0`, `onChange: (n: number) => void`, `max?: number = 5`.

### ToggleButtonGroup
Segmented single/multi select.
Props: `options: string[]` (required), `value: string | string[]`, `onChange: fn`, `multiple?: boolean = false` (value is an array when true).

### TransferList
Dual-list with move buttons. Props: `items: string[]` (starts in left list).

## Data display

### Avatar
Props: `initials: string`, `size?: "sm" | "md" | "lg" = "md"`.

### Badge
Status pill.
Props: `variant: "default" | "accent" | "success" | "warning" | "error" = "default"`, `dot?: boolean = false`, `children: node`.
```jsx
<Badge variant="success" dot>deployed</Badge>
```

### Chip
Tag, optionally removable.
Props: `variant?: "default" | "accent" = "default"`, `onRemove?: fn` (shows ✕ when set), `children: node`.

### Divider
`<hr />` hairline. No props.

### Icon
Stroke-based inline SVG, inherits currentColor.
Props: `name: string` (required), `size?: number = 20`.
Names: search, plus, minus, check, close, arrowRight, arrowLeft, chevronDown, trash, edit, download, settings, user, home, bell, copy, star. Import `ICON_NAMES` for the full list.
```jsx
<Icon name="search" size={16} />
```

### ImageList
Grid of gradient tiles. Props: `items: { label: string, hue: number }[]`, `columns?: number = 3`.

### Kbd
Keyboard key cap. Props: `children: node` (e.g. `⌘`).

### List / ListItem
```jsx
<List><ListItem selected secondary="42s" onClick={fn}>web-prod</ListItem></List>
```
ListItem props: `selected?: boolean`, `secondary?: string`, `onClick?: fn`, `children: node`.

### Skeleton
Shimmer placeholder. Props: `width?: number | string = "100%"`, `height?: number = 14`, `style?: object`.

### Table
Props: `columns: string[]` (required), `rows: any[][]` (required).
```jsx
<Table columns={["Name", "Status"]} rows={[["web-prod", "running"]]} />
```

### Tooltip
Props: `label: string` (required), `children: node` (required, the trigger).
```jsx
<Tooltip label="Neon, as promised"><Button>Hover me</Button></Tooltip>
```

### Typography
Props: `variant?: "h1"|"h2"|"h3"|"h4"|"h5"|"h6"|"subtitle"|"body1"|"body2"|"caption"|"mono" = "body1"`, `as?: string` (override tag).

## Feedback

### Alert
Props: `variant?: "info" | "success" | "warning" | "error" = "info"`, `title?: string`, `children: node`.

### Backdrop
Full-screen blurred overlay. Props: `open: boolean`, `onClose?: fn`, `children: node`.

### Dialog (alias: Modal)
Modal with header/footer; closes on Esc and outside click. Portals to document.body.
Props: `open: boolean`, `onClose: fn`, `title?: string`, `footer?: node`, `children: node`.
```jsx
<Dialog open={open} onClose={close} title="Delete?" footer={<Button variant="danger">Delete</Button>}>No undo.</Dialog>
```

### Progress
Props: `value?: number = 0` (0–100).

### Toast (alias: Snackbar)
Transient notification.
Props: `variant?: "default" | "success" | "warning" | "error" | "info" = "default"`, `title: string`, `description?: string`, `onClose?: fn`.

### Spinner
Indeterminate loader. No props.

## Surfaces

### Accordion
Props: `items: { title: string, content: node }[] = []`, `allowMultiple?: boolean = false`.

### AppBar
Top bar container. Props: `children: node`, `style?: object`.

### Card
Props: `title?: string`, `description?: string`, `footer?: node`, `hoverable?: boolean = false`, `children?: node`.
```jsx
<Card title="Pro plan" description="For teams" hoverable footer={<Button size="sm">Upgrade</Button>}>Unlimited projects</Card>
```

### Paper
Props: `elevation?: number = 0` (0–4 shadow depth), `children: node`.

### EmptyState
Props: `icon?: string = "◇"`, `title: string`, `description?: string`, `action?: node`.

## Navigation

### BottomNavigation
Props: `items: { label: string, icon: node }[]`, `value: string`, `onChange: (v: string) => void`.

### Breadcrumb
Props: `items: string[]` (last item = current page).

### Drawer
Side panel. Props: `open: boolean`, `onClose: fn`, `side?: "left" | "right" = "left"`, `title?: string`, `children: node`.

### Link
Props: `href?: string = "#"`, `accent?: boolean = false`, `children: node`.

### Menu
Dropdown. Props: `trigger: node`, `items: { label: string, icon?: node }[]`, `onSelect?: (label: string) => void`.

### Pagination
Props: `page: number`, `pageCount: number`, `onChange: (p: number) => void`.

### Stepper
Props: `steps: string[]`, `current?: number = 0`.

### Tabs
Props: `tabs: { label: string, content: node }[]`, `initial?: number = 0`.

## Layout

### Box
Plain div passthrough.

### Container
Props: `maxWidth?: number = 1100`.

### Grid
Props: `columns?: number = 2`, `spacing?: number = 2` (gap in 8px units).

### Stack
Props: `direction?: "row" | "column" = "column"`, `spacing?: number = 2`.

## Utils

### ClickAwayListener
Props: `onClickAway: fn`, `children: node`.

### Popover (alias: Popper)
Props: `trigger: node`, `children: node`.

### Portal
Renders children into document.body. Props: `children: node`.

### Transitions
`<Fade show>`, `<Collapse show>`, `<Slide show direction>` — Props: `show?: boolean = true`, `duration?: number = 250`, Slide also `direction?: "up"|"down"|"left"|"right" = "up"`.

### NoSsr
Renders children after mount only. Props: `children: node`.

### useMediaQuery
Hook. `const narrow = useMediaQuery("(max-width: 720px)")`.

### InitColorSchemeScript
Inline script component; put in `<body>` of index.html to restore saved theme before paint.

### CssBaseline
No-op; the global reset ships in the library CSS.

## AI

### Chat (ChatBubble, TypingIndicator)
Chat thread container. Wrap in `aria-live="polite"` for announcements.
ChatBubble props: `variant?: "user" | "assistant" = "assistant"`, `time?: string`, `children: node`. TypingIndicator takes no props.
```jsx
<Chat>
  <ChatBubble variant="user" time="14:02">Deploy to prod</ChatBubble>
  <ChatBubble variant="assistant" time="14:02">Build #421 passed.</ChatBubble>
  <TypingIndicator />
</Chat>
```

### CommandPalette
⌘K launcher with keyboard nav (↑↓ ↵ Esc).
Props: `open: boolean`, `onClose: fn`, `commands: { label, icon?, hint?, onSelect? }[] = []`, `placeholder?: string`.
```jsx
<CommandPalette open={open} onClose={close}
  commands={[{ label: "Deploy", icon: "↑", hint: "⇧D", onSelect: deploy }]} />
```

## Blocks (extended)

### AvatarGroup
Props: `people: { initials: string }[]`, `max?: number = 3` (then shows +N).

### Stat
Metric card. Props: `label: string`, `value: string`, `delta?: string`, `trend?: "up" | "down" = "up"`.

### Timeline
Props: `items: { title, description?, time?, color?: "accent"|"green"|"red"|"muted" }[]`.

### Sparkline
Props: `data: number[]`, `width?: number = 120`, `height?: number = 36`, `color?: "lime"|"green"|"red"|"blue" = "lime"`, `area?: boolean = false`.

### Banner
Announcement strip. Props: `variant?: "accent" | "dark" = "accent"`, `onClose?: fn`, `children: node`.

### OTPInput
Props: `length?: number = 6`, `value: string`, `onChange: fn`, `onComplete?: fn`.

### TagInput
Props: `tags: string[]`, `onChange: fn`, `placeholder?: string`. Enter/comma adds; Backspace removes.

### FileUpload
Props: `onFiles?: (files: FileList) => void`, `accept?: string`, `multiple?: boolean = true`, `title?/hint?: string`.

### ProgressRing
Props: `value?: number = 0`, `size?: number = 72`, `stroke?: number = 6`, `color?: string = "var(--accent)"`, `showValue?: boolean = true`.

## Extended props on existing components

- Input: `leading?: ReactNode`, `trailing?: ReactNode` — adornments inside a joined wrapper.
- Alert: `onClose?: fn` — renders a labelled ✕ button.
- Card: `accent?: boolean` — lime top border.
